title: lulas lead over flavio bolsonaro narrows ahead brazil election quaest poll shows 2026 09 02
text: SAO PAULO, Sept 2 (Reuters) - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio ​Lula da Silva's lead over right-wing ‌challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro narrowed further ahead of October's election, with the two locked in ​a technical tie, a Quaest poll ​commissioned by Globo showed on Wednesday.
